description: Get a single deck by id, including its card count and (optionally) its cards.

includeCards.description: If true, also fetch and include the deck’s cards (all of them by default).

limit.description: With includeCards: max cards to fetch. Omit to fetch ALL cards.

offset.description: With includeCards: 0-based card offset. Omit to fetch ALL cards.

name: get_deck
title: Get deck
